messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert at 2350001234 - kv-cache continuous-batching surge detected in us-east-1. Streaming token cadence stalls observed. Pager: @oncall-ryan

oncall-ryan: ack. I'm on it, pulling metrics now.

sre-alex: looking at grafana -> eviction_rate spike 48k/min, kv_cache_bytes growth 2.7x, batch_size amplification ~3x. p95 gen latency up to 3.6s. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache

ml-kate: repro on canary: partial-flush queue length grows steadily, streaming emitter stalls at regular token cadence until backlog clears, then big token bursts. Seems like partial-flush bug interacting with continuous-batching.

eng-runtime-lina: prepping hotfix to tune batching heuristics + disable streaming partial flush as an emergency toggle. Proposed config snippet:

```
continuous_batch_threshold: 0.5
max_batch_size: 64
kv_cache_target_ratio: 0.7
eviction_smear_ms: 120000
streaming_partial_flush_enabled: false
```

support-teri: incoming CS: multiple customers report timeouts and 5–10s latencies; two Dedicated customers with 500s on generation webhook. Triaging.

oncall-ryan: initiating canary rollout now. Runbook:
1) apply hotfix to canary pool
2) monitor eviction_rate, p95 latency, error-rate
3) if stable for 5m, increment 15% until 100%

deploybot: rolling update started for group=canary by oncall-ryan. status: in_progress

sre-alex: canary report at +30s -> eviction_rate down ~60%, partial-flush queue drained, p95 dropped to ~0.9s. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: config rollout stage=canary -> success

pm-omar: need customer impact summary for comms. ETA on full rollout?

oncall-ryan: if canary stays stable next 2m I'll continue with staged rollout. current plan OK.

sre-alex: staged rollout at 2350001500 -> 60% done. metrics stable. No new 5xx spikes.

eng-runtime-lina: also pushing a small runtime guard patch to throttle batch amplification when kv-cache growth rate > 1.5x. PR: https://git/redwood/pr/1234 (will follow up with postmortem code link)

ml-kate: adding an eval to CI to simulate high-token-reuse traces and ensure streaming cadence doesn't collapse under continuous batching; will land tomorrow.

support-teri: customer-impact window preliminary: 00:12–00:28 UTC. Affected customers: BetaCorps (timeout on webhook), FinPlatform (intermittent slowdowns). No data loss or exposure.

oncall-anna: taking over the incident from Ryan. Handoff notes: canary -> success, rolled to 100% at 2350001600. Will monitor alerts and keep thresholds lowered for 2h. :eyes:

oncall-ryan: notes for postmortem: root cause likely interplay between prefix-prefetch optimizer and recent scheduler widening of batch cutoff, which allowed larger-than-intended aggregation. Action items: revert prefetch optimizer in next patch, add canary workload test, improve observability on KV insert churn.

sre-alex: added mitigation in autoscaler: if kv_cache_size_per_pod > 80% then serve soft-reject (429) to new writes to stabilize cache churn. Config deployed to us-east-1.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2350001800. Timeline exported to #incidents-log/2350001234. :white_check_mark:

support-teri: drafting customer incident email and internal RCA, ping me for copy review.

oncall-anna: closing thread — continue monitoring for 2h. If pattern reappears we escalate to SEV.

oncall-ryan: leaving detailed notes in the incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/2350001234

sre-alex: follow-ups assigned: ENG-789 (revert prefetch optimizer), SRE-456 (canary test), ML-321 (eval), CS-112 (customer comms).
